# T01 implementation evidence

## Scope and authority

T01 implements the accepted WB38 contracts and readiness amendment on
codex/task-38-core-batching, targeting codex/feature-38-playbook-efficiency via
[PR42](https://github.com/hhhhhusky777/spec-driven-delivery-playbook/pull/42).
HUMAN_REVIEW_BEFORE_MERGE remains selected. T02, installed runtime, pin,
installer defects and historical examples are unchanged.

The owner reaffirmed the consolidated readiness check during implementation.
The shared guide now states one pre-start check and planning-time verification
that prerequisites are achievable. This implements the agreed readiness
boundary; it does not modify the immutable whiteboard conclusion.

review work. The optional publication helper and its live demonstration remain
T02; T01 documents an existing-tool coordinator route.
